claim.claim-text: 1. A control body (102, 202) for an electronic smoking article (100, 200), the control body comprising:
2. The control body of claim 1, wherein the one or more different waveforms directly correspond to an instruction from the control component (106, 206).
3. The control body of claim 2, wherein the one or more different waveforms vary based upon an input provided to the control component (106, 206).
4. The control body of claim 1, wherein the one or more different waveforms are predetermined to correspond to a specific status of the electronic smoking article.
5. The control body of claim 1, wherein the haptic driver (222) is combined with the control component (106, 206).
6. The control body of claim 1, wherein the haptic driver (222) is an independent element from the control component (106, 206).
7. The control body of claim 1, wherein the haptic driver (222) is an external differential amplifier.
8. The control body of claim 1, wherein the haptic driver (222) is integrated into a single integrated circuit along with a haptics processor.
9. The control body of claim 1, wherein the haptic feedback component (101, 220) is a vibrating haptic actuator, and optionally wherein one or more of the following conditions is met;
10. The control body of claim 1, further comprising one or both of a flow sensor (108, 208) and an LED (112, 212) within the housing.

11. The control body of claim 1, wherein the haptic driver (222) is adapted to convert one or more signals from the control component (106, 206) to an output that directs the haptic feedback component (101, 220) to generate the one or more different waveforms defining haptic feedback.
a control body (102, 202) according to any one of claims 1 to 11; and a cartridge (104, 204) including an aerosol precursor composition, the cartridge configured to engage the control body.

13. The electronic smoking article of claim 12, wherein the cartridge comprises an electronic component (250) adapted to communicate with one or both of the haptic feedback component (101, 220) and the microcontroller (106, 206) of the control body so as to provide an input, and optionally wherein the input includes attachment of the cartridge (104, 204) to the control body (102, 202).
14. The electronic smoking article of claim 12, wherein the cartridge (104, 204) engaged with the control body (102, 202) includes a heater (134, 234) therein.

15. The electronic smoking article of claim 12, wherein the cartridge (104, 204) is adapted to engage the control body (102, 202) to establish a connection between the control body (102, 202) and the cartridge (104, 204) as well as to establish an electrical connection between the electrical power source (110, 210) and the control component (106, 206) in the control body (102, 202) and the heater (134, 234) in the cartridge (104, 204).
